brief: A little more platform sheen with cool reference lighting; no water; preserve scene geometry and terrain.

critics.assessment: Platforms read as dry satin with visible tile texture and restrained highlights. Roofs no longer resemble polished metal; fog supports depth. Cool atmosphere and warm workshop light are balanced.
Floors read as dry satin metal, roof highlights stay subordinate, and darker gaps restore depth. The modest sheen increase is clear without a wet appearance.

refinements: Reduced floor highlight peaks by increasing roughness to 0.42
Reduced helper-light powers and clear coat
Assigned roofs a separate matte powdercoat finish
Retained localized warm Workshop task lighting
